text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
Business:
BURSA
- The upper house, the Senate, may debate a bill on local investors in an extraordinary session at the end of this week.
- The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development will grant a $300 million or $400 million loan to Romania's National Oil Company, said the Industry Minister Calin Tariceanu.
- The national news agency Rompres faces big financial problems, said its manager Constantin Badea. For the fourth quarter of 1997 it will get only 100 million lei.
ADEVARUL
- The president of the state-owned Banca Agricola resigned.
- Labour Minister said unpaid taxes to the state social insurance budget are worth one trillion lei.
- Foreign investment in Romania at end-June stood at $2.57 billion.
CURIERUL NATIONAL
- The chamber of deputies lower house adopted a government decree changing the law on commercial companies.
- With an annual output of some six million hectolitres, Romania takes eighth place in the world in wine production.
General:
All newspapers report on the decision taken by the 16 NATO members at the summit in Madrid to name Romania for a second wave of eastward enlargment to start in 1999.
ADEVARUL
- As many as two murders, six rapes, and 40 robberies are commited in Romania daily, police said.
- The newspaper publishes a report on labour on the black market in Romania.
CURIERUL NATIONAL
- The Chamber of Deputies approved a bill to pardon 9,000 prisoners.

- Virgil Magureanu, former head of the Romanian Intelligence Service, is to testify in the trial of miners' boss Miron Cosma charged with undermining state authority in miner-led riots which toppled the government in 1991.
- President Emil Constantinescu promulgated the law granting special benefits to families having more than two children and a law granting a two-year paid maternity leave.
- The Alliance for Romania, including dissidents from the former ruling Party of Social Democracy, is to be registered as a party within a month, said Marian Enache, one of its leaders.
- The Chamber of Deputies adopted a bill to return some properties to the Jewish community confiscated by the communists.
ROMANIA LIBERA
- Rubens Barrichello, the formula one driver, is to attend the first international edition of the Romanian car show.
- Fishing licences bring in many millions of lei, says the newspaper in a report on the Danube Delta.
- The level of underground waters in Bucharest rose three meters after the banks of the river Dimbovita were put in concrete. ($=7,114 lei)
-- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
